title: Cassata Cake
description: A gluten-free Italian dessert made with airy sponge cake and sweet cassata filling.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, vanilla extract, and almond extract.
In a large bowl, whisk together cake flour, powdered sugar, and airy sponge cake.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into a greased 8-inch round cake pan.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let the cake cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
In a separate bowl, whip the sweetened whipped cream until stiff peaks form.
To assemble the cake, place the cooled cake on a serving plate and spread the cassata filling over the top.
Top the cassata filling with the whipped cream and sprinkle with chocolate shavings.
Dust the top of the cake with powdered sugar before serving.
